method: Three remaining fresh paired cohorts on unchanged B1 source/image/helper; owned identity metadata before unchanged unexpected-child stop. Old diagnostic and stopped cohorts remain separate immutable evidence.

definitions.scope: This fresh paired policy cohort only; no earlier pilots, diagnostics or deployed-fleet data are pooled.
definitions.pairedPolicyBenefit: candidate warm versus production warm within matching artifact/MTP/block; negative reductions are retained regressions
definitions.parityQualification: within-arm donor/fork parity plus exact production/candidate output fingerprints for all four matching roles; only equality booleans are exported
definitions.withinArmBenefit: cold versus warm within one policy; distinct from paired policy improvement
definitions.generationTPS: (completed output tokens-firstOutputTokenCount)/(last-first native output event); MTP may emit multiple IDs per event
definitions.endToEndTPS: completed output tokens/native terminal duration; current COMPLETE publication precedes terminal delivery; later explicit quiescence is separate
definitions.receiptCompletionTPS: completed output tokens/receiptCompletionSeconds; distinct literal receipt-boundary rate
definitions.quiescenceCompletionTPS: completed output tokens/quiescenceCompletionSeconds after explicit idle and owned checkpoint writer/activity joins; no fsync durability claim
definitions.publicationTiming: Current COMPLETE terminal delivery waits for publication; explicit quiescence certifies any remaining idle/pipeline/activity tail rather than removing donor cost from prior rates.
definitions.TTFT: first nonempty native token delta since staging/submit; hash/load/assembly excluded
definitions.quantiles: median of three paired values; no pooled p95 or reliability claim from three pairs
definitions.donorCost: candidate demanded-donor versus production demanded-donor, plus novel/demanded contrast per arm and actual file/byte/write time
definitions.peaks: store-lifetime cumulative maxima, not reset per-request physical/RSS peaks
definitions.MTP: actual before/after snapshots and positive per-row drafting/verification/emission deltas; accepted0 is allowed
definitions.cacheRoot: fresh process and source-created UUID per arm; no emitted root identity proof

limits: Benchmark-only recurrent/long partition stays outside serving policy.
strictFsync=false and ephemeral keys do not qualify fsync durability or separate physical disk from OS cache.
Partial/failed arms are retained but do not enter qualified three-pair medians.
Exact within-arm output parity does not imply all-workload or full-state tensor equivalence.
MTP modes differ from earlier MTP-off pilots; this cohort is kept separate.
privacy: Only aggregate numeric counters, public model IDs and artifact/source/binary qualification are exported; no local paths, raw token IDs, output fingerprints, prompts, logprobs, provider or account IDs.
